Type: deco
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Medallion Decorative Throw Pillow, 17" x 17", Aqua
Colors: Aqua
Materials: Rayon/polyester/cotton
This artisanal pillow features medallion shapes with hints of Moroccan tile. The eye-catching design is a perfect blend of modern and classic, while a velvet back, resilient pillow insert and hidden zipper provide high quality touches. Sophisticated, artisanal style has modern and classic touches Rayon/polyester/cotton blend front with velvet back Pillow Cover Front:42% Rayon, 30% Polyester, 28% Cotton. Pillow Cover Back: 100% Polyester. Insert Shell: 100% Cotton. Stuffing: 100% Polyester Made in USA and Imported Removable plush fiber-filled insert included Pillow cover features hidden bottom zipper 17" x 17" Spot clean with damp white cloth and allow to air dry
